name: Tinker Tess
bio: Fixes clockwork critters on Coppergate Lane and is VERY upset about the Mayor's Golden Gear.

portrait.subject: a cute soot-streaked young tinker girl with copper goggles on her forehead, curly red hair, a leather tool belt and a little brass gear in her hand
portrait.background: warm cozy copper workshop with steam

request: Tess here, from Coppergate Lane! Big Bertha stole the Golden Gear. Help me get it back? Friends first! ⚙️
hello: Brilliant! I'll build you something. Probably a toaster.
The clockwork critters are cranky lately. Be careful!
about: I'm Tess, the lane's tinker. I fix things, build things and sometimes blow things up. On purpose. Mostly.
how: Walk with the arrows or WASD (or tap), talk with Space, and press H for where to go next. Gather scrap for Trina, find Mabel's kettle and run Bertram's errands to build a party, then win back the Golden Gear from Big Bertha.
tips: Help the townsfolk: Trina and Mabel both join your party once their errands are done.
Scrap is useful! Keep five for Trina, she builds you a Spark Rod.
Bertha telegraphs her big slam a turn ahead. Defend, or let Mabel wrap everyone in a Cosy Blanket.
Rust Crabs hide in their shells, then rust your armour. Hit them when the shell is down.
Bandits pinch your gold! Beat the thief and it all jingles back.
Level 6 is a good time to visit Bertha, and stock up on tea and scones first.
chat: Built a clockwork bird. It flew into a window. Twice.
The tea shop gave me extra tea for fixing their kettle.
Big Bertha is not THAT big. She's medium Bertha at most.
I have grease on my nose again, don't I.
nudge: The townsfolk have new quests! Come help?
The Golden Gear won't rescue itself! Let's go!
idle: {ago}! The lane's clocks all stopped without you. (Not really. But it felt like it.)
Haven't seen you on the lane in {ago}!

a: On it! What could go wrong? 🔧

update: Fresh from the workshop: Coppergate Lane is now v{version}!

updates.2.0.0: Big news: the lane got a proper rebuild! You can save now, Trina and Mabel can join your party, every critter fights its own way, and it is all painted and has real sound effects. Bertha got a lot tougher too.
